notes.title: ✨ Update 1.5.0 is out!✨
notes.notes:
We're back, with an exciting new update!

What's new:

 A new slime. One might say this one is pretty familiar...
 Several new structures and items related to mining!
 A special endgame mechanic for obtaining resources, unlocked by completing several quests


Improvements:

 A slight adjustment to the RNG when generating shop.
 Changes to how energy-generating structures work. Steam Generator now only consumes the appropriate amount of water based on your energy capacity, rather than all of them.


Thanks for sticking around! Feedback and suggestions are appreciated!

notes.title: ✨ Update 1.4.0 is out ✨
notes.notes:
What's new in v1.4.0:

🤖 New content:


 6 new slimes to discover
 A new structure to help you shape your world


⚡ Changes:


 Dungeons can no longer be overridden by the Forces of Nature slimes
 Wool Scarf can now be crafted
 You can now enable/disable which recipes a machine can handle (only for the 7 machines, also note that the machines will still consume energy even if no recipe is enabled)
 Island inspector UI has been changed for better visibility


🔧 Bug Fixes:


 Background music now plays properly
 Fixed some translation errors
 Recipes with a specified success chance (like Floral Essence) now display it properly in the archive
 Fixed stamina reset when continue playing existing game

notes.title: 🔥❄️🍃 Update v1.3.0: The Forces of Nature 🔥❄️🍃
notes.notes:
Hello keepers! Hope you had a wonderful time celebrating New Year's Eve. 

This time, we bring you a new update to Ooze Keeper—Update v1.3.0: The Forces of Nature. Get your hands on some new slimes with the abilities to terraform the world!

New content


 5 new slimes, several new structures and items to expand on the magical side 🪄
 A new biome to boost the production of your farm 🌱
 There's now Harsh Sunlight weather ☀️


Tweaks


 Elixirs of Harvest receive a nerf, now requiring an additional new rare ingredient ⚗️
 Ritual Site now spawns 100% of the time but spawns further away from the origin island. Darkness Slime can be used to help you locate the Ritual Site. The glitchy visual effect of the Ritual Site is now only visible when inspecting that specific island ⛤


Improvements


 There's now an option in the settings menu that lets you change UI scale.
 The game simulation process can now run in the background. Note that the application will only run in the background when simulation slimes/structures.


Bug fixes


 Fix free rerolls and reroll cost reset when loading.
 Fix unintentional behavior of grass spreading to non-arable islands.
 Fix some inconsistency in some localization strings.


Developer notes

This update is somewhat light on new content, and that's because most of the development is focused on optimization of the behaviors of slimes and structures. It's not perfect in anyway. Therefore, your feedback and suggestions are really appreciated. The best way to reach out is joining our Discord server. 
Thanks for the support and hope you have a wonderful 2025!

notes.title: ✨ Update 1.2.1: Some minor tweaks and fixes ✨
notes.notes:
Improvements


 Lucky Cat Slime received a slight buff
 There's now a setting option to switch between full screen and windowed mode


Bug Fixes


 Upgraded the simulation system for slimes/structures that contain other slimes/structures for more consistent behaviors
 Rabbit Slimes burrowing no longer spawn Ghost Slimes when Phantom Conversion is active

notes.title: ✨ Update v1.2.0 is out! ✨
notes.notes:
Hey there, Keepers! Thanks for being part of the Ooze Keeper world. The holidays are here, and we want to wish you a very Merry Christmas! 🎁

📋 New content


 🧬 5 new slimes to discover
 🪴 New structures and items to complement the newly included slimes, including a new crop to synergize with Farm Animal Slimes


🚀 Improvements


 🖥️ UI improvements, including hotkeys for easy access
 🐄 Slight change to the Barn's breeding mechanic. 1 fence should be enough
 🪙 Reduce island unlocking price
 🌵 Cactus is now affected by Dryad Slime
 📦 Slimes/Structures that handle recipes have their batch size increased to infinity. Note that this means no more even distribution of items


🔧 Bug Fixes


 📈 Correct some slimes' production bonus stat
 💤 Fix Caffeine/Engineer Slime not working correctly
 🌽 Corrupted Animal Slimes now require the correct food item to breed using the Barn
 🌳 Fix localization issue with the Ore Tree
 🪙 Remove the money cap used for testing purpose

notes.title: ✨ Minor update v1.1.1: Tweaks and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Tweaks:


 Corrupted Animal Slimes is now targeted by Butcher Slimes.
 Removed the splash screen.


Bug Fixes:


 Dreamcatcher Slimes no longer fall asleep.
 Fixed repeated purchases using stellars.
 Small adjustment to the achievement system.

notes.title: ✨ Update v1.1.0 is out! ✨
notes.notes:
✨ New contents


 7 new slime types, including 1 gimmick slime type that introduces Automated Slime Breeding.
 New structures, items and modifiers to compliment the newly added slimes.


✨ Improvements


 Visual effect indicating combinations that you've already tried. No more note taking!
 A timeline bar with markers indicating upcoming shops.
 Updated descriptions to recipe handler structures and slimes to be clearer.


✨ Bug Fixes


 Fixed Nature, Potato, Quarry and Crystal Slimes not consuming required resources even when available.
 Fixed Butcher Slime locked from attempting to kill a breeding slime.
 Fixed the calculation of islands position relativity.
 Fixed camera navigation using WASD not working.
 And some other minor bugs.

notes.title: ✨ Demo Update v0.1: Large Island & Distributor ✨
notes.notes:
🎉 Hey there, keepers!

We're thrilled to bring you the first ever update for the Ooze Keeper demo! Your feedback has been invaluable and helped us go a long way.

📘 What's New:

1. Large Island 🏝️:
We've made some changes to the grid-based island system to support larger islands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145584/f47a92aeb1b157a5f9a12ba47d1d9ba6abb3f233.png

2. The Distributor 📦:
Introducing the Distributor. Directly feed your cows, water your crops using items from the inventory. Logistic at its finest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145584/a2371d62309fe8a08734b8f5c03dc7b742964cd9.png

3. Bug Fix 🔧:
Fix the bug with the tutorial sequence not playing when starting a new run.
